objective.target: Match or exceed the declared Sol Ultra teacher on fresh held-out Kumi tasks with a smaller local model.
objective.claim_boundary: No claim of matching general frontier-model capability; synthetic and real-DAW results remain separate.

teacher.captured_output: Public assistant tool actions and final text plus actual Kumi tool results.
teacher.provenance_limit: The collector records the orchestrator-requested model and transport. Admission cannot independently authenticate a model provider.

current_pilot.status: Existing v1 LoRA pilot continues on its immutable v1 snapshot.

next_comparison.selection_status: Not selected; choose only after compatibility, long-context memory, and held-out task profiling.
next_comparison.control: Compare unmodified base and trained adapter for every selected student.

task_families: MIDI writing with exact note readback and preservation of existing clips
Selective undo that preserves a preceding requested edit
Deferred transport discovery and seek without starting playback
Producer-scoped preference persisted and applied on a subsequent turn
pilot.admission: Whole episode requires independent final-state checks, preservation of unrelated state, complete captured calls, clean successful matching tool results and exact teacher provenance.
pilot.failure_policy: Preserve failed attempts in quarantine; never use a failed teacher action as a positive label.
pilot.readiness: Train-only pilot outputs are allowed but explicitly lack validation/test coverage. Full tokenization and target-mask checks remain required before training.

observed_result.note: Original false-negative verifier outcomes are preserved; corrected targeted reruns are new raw episodes. These are curation counts, not teacher benchmark scores.

expansion.scale_condition: Expand only after pilot admission, tokenizer and curriculum-coverage checks pass; grow according to measured student failures and budget.
initial_task_families: Gain, pan and sends in native/display units
MIDI construction and exact note editing
Capability-gap reporting and refusal without side effects
expansion.policy_note: The current clean-episode gate does not admit failed-action recovery traces. A separately reviewed per-step recovery policy is needed before using those histories as training data.
expansion.data_separation: Do not modify the currently running v1 pilot or its snapshots. Version and validate any future combined corpus separately.

group_rules: All expanded assistant prefixes from one source episode remain together.
All related project variants remain in one split.
Hold out goal-program compositions and project layouts, not merely renamed copies.
split_and_leakage_control.held_out_evaluation: Freeze separate fresh task manifests and expected-state checks before collecting teacher training demonstrations. Keep checks unavailable to the teacher training role.
exclusions: Original 18-case benchmark episodes and close case copies
Any held-out competition task or teacher answer for it
Teacher-private reasoning or fabricated tool observations
split_and_leakage_control.selection: Use validation for configuration/checkpoint selection; keep final test sealed until the student configuration is frozen.
split_and_leakage_control.freeze_timing: The initial four pilot families were defined independently before teacher collection. The separate 40-task heldout specification is frozen before curriculum expansion; it is not an executed benchmark.

comparison_protocol.status: Evaluation manifest and budgets must be frozen before runs; not executed by this plan.
controlled_inputs: Same initial project state and scenario seed
Same Kumi instructions and active/deferred tool definitions
Same grounded observations and tool-result semantics
Same public-action, tool-call and per-turn wall-clock limits
comparison_protocol.attempt_accounting: Score every held-out attempt, including errors and timeouts. Do not filter the denominator to successful teacher cases.
comparison_protocol.transport_limit: The file-queue Codex teacher has an outer adapter prompt and orchestration overhead. Record those differences; do not present it as identical native API inference.
comparison_protocol.latency_reporting: Measure end-to-end latency and queue/tool overhead separately where observable. Do not invent inference-only latency, provider cost or reasoning-token counts.

frozen_specification.requires: isolated evaluator initializer and predicate adapter

metrics.primary: Episode success: requested goal reached with no unrequested mutations.
secondary: Latency, model-call count and memory footprint
metrics.uncertainty: Report trial counts, paired task-level differences and uncertainty intervals; do not turn a small synthetic sample into a production accuracy estimate.
metrics.competitive_criterion: Only claim domain competitiveness after matched held-out attempts support comparable or better success with the desired size/latency/resource tradeoff.

requirements: Actual API readback and preservation checks
Rendered audio and independent listening where the target concerns sound
real_daw_stage.reporting: Keep actual Live execution, audible quality and synthetic-tool success as distinct evidence.
